projects.title: Projects
projects.description: A curated set of projects that shows how I think about product, structure interfaces, and deliver complete experiences from frontend to backend.

gastrogourmet.description: A restaurant SaaS platform that brings orders, menus, customers, expenses, and reports into one multi-store operation. It connects automated WhatsApp service to the staff dashboard, organizes the kitchen workflow on an operational board, and provides plan, user, and visual identity management for each business.

maxCatalog.description: A complete digital catalog for MAX Elétrica & Construção, featuring a responsive public storefront, product and category search, and list creation for WhatsApp-assisted sales. It includes a secure dashboard for managing products, images, categories, display order, and staff access with different permission levels.

blogPessegos.description: Editorial blog built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Sanity Content Lake for Pessegos em Setembro. It delivers a comfortable reading experience with original visual identity, Sanity-published content, and simple serverless deployment.

medicalService.description: Service order management system developed with React (front-end) and Node.js + MongoDB (back-end). Allows creating, managing, and signing service orders digitally through a signature resource with canvas, in addition to exporting them as PDF. The interface is fully responsive, ensuring a smooth experience on any device, with intuitive navigation and efficient workflow.

blogAPI.description: API RESTful for blog with authentication and relationships.

pingPresenca.description: Web prototype for the Ânima group college attendance system. Professors generate temporary attendance codes, students register attendance with those codes, and SSO authentication runs through Keycloak.

gestaoBackend.description: Node.js + MongoDB backend for personal finance management, with Keycloak authentication, categories, expenses, income, recurrent items, monthly periods, category reports, and AI-powered financial analysis.

gestaoFront.description: Flutter personal finance app integrated with the Node.js backend and Keycloak. It includes a monthly dashboard, expense and income tracking, custom categories, recurrence, period history, category charts, and a Material Design 3 interface localized for Brazilian Portuguese.

trybeSmithAPI.description: API for a medieval shop with authentication and product CRUD.

RegistraEmpregadoAPI.description: Simple API for employee registration and management by department, developed as an academic project. Allows for adding, listing, updating, and removing employees, associating them with different departments. The focus was on applying back-end development concepts, best practices in code organization, and structured data consumption.

recipesApp.description: Recipe application developed with React and Context API, allowing for searching, creating, and sharing recipes.

FacilitaServico.description: Facilita Serviços is a web platform developed with Quasar Framework to connect clients and self-employed professionals from various fields, facilitating service hiring, scheduling, profile management, and chat communication.
